question: Should crawl-remote deployments permanently seed this hidden D1 canary and require the predecessor runtime to support canary and exact query-release provenance before the stack can land?
rationale: Tests can validate the mechanics, but automation cannot choose the durable hosted-data lifecycle or accept the intentional fail-closed rollout and rollback contract on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Approve gated permanent canary
options.body: Accept the durable canary contract after https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/550 and https://github.com/openclaw/crawl-remote/pull/40 land in the required order and staged live deploy and rollback proof passes.

options.title: Redesign the lifecycle
options.body: Keep the query oracle but replace permanent retention with a maintainer-approved versioned cleanup, migration, or isolated canary-storage contract before merge.

options.title: Pause the deployment stack
options.body: Leave this draft unmerged until the hosted Gitcrawl rollout and rollback policy is settled outside this PR.

recommendation.title: Approve gated permanent canary
recommendation.body: Accept the durable canary contract after https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/550 and https://github.com/openclaw/crawl-remote/pull/40 land in the required order and staged live deploy and rollback proof passes.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the connected Gitcrawl evidence and deployment stack and can present the exact rollout, rollback, and data-lifecycle contract for approval.
